ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions versus 35% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels on the lateral lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous dark region extending from the peduncle attachment to the median notch. Distal tips of both lobes exhibit high-frequency dark mottling. Large high-intensity (white) geometric patches occupy the medial-to-lateral areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 120 degrees and shallow depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys, particularly towards the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; left lobe maintains a consistent outward curve, while the right lobe exhibits a more erratic, stepped convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of dark circular pixel groups on the distal tip of the right lobe; secondary cluster of lower density on the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal dark linear disruption located on the medial section of the right lobe; one shorter vertical linear mark on the medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation and potential tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; distinct rake marks visible as parallel dark linear disruptions on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The central dark pigmentation forms a distinct 'W' shape across the horizontal axis of the fluke surface.
